title: Location of Merged School at Bedok North Secondary School
what_it_is: Location of Merged School at Bedok North Secondary School

sections.label: Secondary school merger announcement
sections.summary: MOE announced 11 pairs of secondary schools merging in 2017 and 2018, with Bedok North and Damai merging in 2018 at the Damai site.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: In March this year, the Ministry of Education (MOE) announced that 11 pairs of secondary schools will be merged in 2017 and 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Bedok North Secondary School and Damai Secondary School will merge in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The decision was to locate the merged school at the Damai Secondary School site for the following reasons.

sections.label: Damai Secondary facilities upgrading
sections.summary: Damai Secondary would have new facilities like an indoor sports hall and synthetic field by end 2018, better than Bedok North Secondary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Damai Secondary School would be equipped with new facilities such as an indoor sports hall and synthetic field when the upgrading is completed by end 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: After the upgrading, the Damai Secondary site would have better and newer facilities compared to Bedok North Secondary.

sections.label: Transport accessibility factors
sections.summary: Transport accessibility and convenience are factors, but not the only factors, as explained in the first response.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The transport accessibility and convenience are factors, but they are not the only factors, as I have explained in the first response.

sections.label: Merged school relocation to Damai
sections.summary: The school will be relocated to Damai Secondary School and the merged school will have better and newer facilities than Bedok North Secondary.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The school will be relocated to Damai Secondary School and the final merged school will have significantly better and newer facilities than are available at Bedok North Secondary.
